items.stem: Where should an API key for an Anthropic integration be stored?

options.text: In a secret store or environment variable, never in source control
options.rationale: Correct: keys must be kept out of code and version control.
Client-side code exposes the key to anyone.

options.text: Committed to the Git repository for the team
options.rationale: Committing keys leaks them to everyone with repo access.
Logging keys exposes them in log stores.

items.explanation: Correct: keys must be kept out of code and version control.

items.stem: Which TWO are sound practices for a production API integration? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Retry transient errors using exponential backoff
options.rationale: Correct: backoff avoids hammering the service on transient failures.
Correct: tracking usage controls cost and catches anomalies.

options.text: Retry every error immediately in a tight loop
options.rationale: Tight-loop retries can worsen outages and hit rate limits.

options.text: Assume responses never need error handling
options.rationale: Errors and rate limits must be handled.

items.explanation: Correct: backoff avoids hammering the service on transient failures.
